```{ojs}
//| echo: false
head = FileAttachment("../x402/data/headline.json").json()

```

## Why the raw number misleads

**TODO(Wes).** Facts you can use, all sourced:

- D05 (arXiv 2607.12575) finds about 85% of Base x402 settlements are operator-internal.
- My lower-bound filter removes much less; see the method box.
- One seller in week 21 Sep had 874 one-time buyers, 10 of 12 sampled funded by the same three wallets (ORDER_010 dig).

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Method box
- **Settlements:** USDC `transferWithAuthorization` calls sent by 128 known x402 facilitators on Base (Blockscout).
- **Manufacture filter:** drops self-payments, closed loops, funding-linked payer–seller pairs, and fan-out funding. It only removes what it can prove, so cleaned numbers are an upper bound on genuine demand.
- **Dust filter:** drops sellers with a single buyer in the week.
- **Categories:** a small model reads each seller's own listing. It agreed with 80% of 30 blind hand labels on content / data / neither.
- **Coverage:** Base only.
- **Full method:** [X402_INDEX_METHOD.md](https://github.com/doescodinggiteasier/wknipe-site/blob/main/docs/X402_INDEX_METHOD.md).
:::
